messages:
sara: Heads-up — branch cutover for v0.12.0 is in ~2h. Please add a one-line changelog entry to your PRs (component: short description). If you absolutely can’t, ping @tim or me here and we’ll handle it, but authors preferred.

 tim: Quick Q — exact shape? Is it `component - short sentence` or `component: short sentence`?

 sara: Use a colon. Example:
```
engine: reduce KV cache thrash for short sequences
```
Keep it present tense, no PR links, and place it under a `Changelog` heading in the PR body. Short = ~8–12 words ideally.

 mike: Also add the `release/bump` label and target the `release/v0.12` branch. If you merge to main after cutoff, I’ll cherry-pick but prefer authors land it correctly.

 tim: If I miss the cutoff, will we auto-backport or do manual edits?

 release-bot: AUTO: Release window closes at 2058767200 UTC. Branch protections will enable 10m before cutoff.

 sara: If you can’t update the PR before cutoff, DM me the one-liner and PR link; we can slot it in manually but we’ll only do that for short, author-provided lines. Anyone planning a longer-format release note, file it in the release-notes repo post-cutoff — not in the one-liner slot.

 mike: :thumbsup:

 tim: On it — trimming mine now and adding the label. Thanks for the example!
